top_news.title: Qwenputer: a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
top_news.dek: Qwenputer embeds a functional RISC-V CPU directly into Qwen 3.5 4B weights, using Gated DeltaNet layers as RAM.
top_news.brief: This experimental model runs arithmetic, C, and MicroPython code entirely within its own forward passes. It operates without external tool usage or plugins, leveraging the model's internal attention architecture for memory.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing RISC-V CPU architecture integrated into neural network layers

top_news.title: Mistral AI: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) is now open weight
top_news.dek: Mistral AI has released the weights for Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model optimized for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
top_news.brief: Mistral Large 4, internally dubbed 'Le Chonk,' is now available as an open-weight model. The 1T parameter model features native multimodality and has been refined through reinforcement learning to improve performance in agentic coding and defensive cybersecurity applications.
top_news.image_alt: Mistral Large 4 partner and technical ecosystem graphic

top_news.title: Can Frontier Models See Past a Decoy? Elorian Tests Visual Reasoning
top_news.dek: Elorian has launched Glimpse, a visual reasoning model designed to bridge the gap between image perception and physical world reasoning.
top_news.brief: Glimpse is a new visual thinking model that aims to improve how AI reasons about physical environments. The release coincides with new benchmarks designed to test whether frontier models can distinguish between actual visual data and deceptive decoys.
top_news.image_alt: Elorian Glimpse visual reasoning benchmark interface

top_news.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays
top_news.dek: Bug0 has introduced a source-available QA agent that automates regression testing using cached Playwright replays.
top_news.brief: The tool maps natural language instructions to UI actions, caching them for faster CI execution. It handles UI changes by remapping tests and uses multi-model consensus and vision-based evaluation to verify test outcomes.

top_news.title: How MoEngage turned over 400 APIs into agent tools with AgentCore Gateway
top_news.dek: MoEngage integrated over 400 private REST APIs into AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
top_news.brief: By leveraging OpenAPI specs, Cedar policies, and Amazon VPC Lattice, MoEngage exposed internal APIs to agents without public endpoints or context window bloat. This approach allows for permission-scoped tool access across multiple AWS regions.
top_news.image_alt: Architecture diagram of MoEngage AgentCore Gateway integration
